title: Booking.com Reviews Scraper
description: Collect Booking.com guest reviews with scores, titles, comments, reviewer names, stay dates, and languages. Batch hotel URLs and page through public feedback.

batch.title: Booking.com hotel URLs
batch.description: Hotel listing URLs whose public guest reviews you want to collect.
batch.valueDescription: Url used to run this search.

schema.description: Public source page URL used to retrieve this record.
Kununu country market code, such as de, at, or ch.
Hotel slug from the Booking.com URL (e.g. ritz-paris). The trailing .html is optional.
Maximum number of company matches requested for this search page.
Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: recent_desc, recent_asc, score_desc, score_asc.

reviews.title: A comfortable city stay
reviews.text: The room was quiet, the staff were attentive, and the location made museums easy to reach.
reviews.positive_text: Helpful staff and a calm room.
reviews.negative_text: Breakfast service was busy before 9 am.
reviews.author: Jordan Lee

storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Booking.com hotel reviews by property URL. Export ratings, text, stay dates, author names, and languages to compare feedback across hotels.
storeCopy.intro: Collect public Booking.com guest reviews with ratings, review text, reviewer names, stay dates, and language labels. Add multiple hotel URLs and page through available reviews.
useCases: Hotel analysts can compare guest feedback and scores across properties.
Travel businesses can monitor public review themes for destination research.
Hospitality teams can track recent feedback and identify service patterns.
howToUse: Add a Booking.com hotel URL to each entry in `hotels`.
Choose review language, currency, sort order, and page size if needed.
Set `maxPages` and `maxResults` to cap the review collection.

faqs.question: Can I use a hotel slug instead of a full URL?
faqs.answer: This Actor accepts hotel URLs in its batch. If you only have a slug and country, open the property page to copy its canonical URL first.
